text_block_list.text:
Autumn of the Senior Class. A rematch 
against BNW. Even though Narita Taishin 
isn't here—

The sheer seriousness Royce and Royce 
dedicated to it was borderline absurd.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa...! My final spurt still 
isn't good enough.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this time it's a serious duel without 
any self-producing.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I have to push all the way and at least 
find a piece of my true core, you know?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
A drama... cannot begin without both 
"wheels" in place.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a passion that rivals Hayahide-san 
and Ticket-san's. Without that in me, 
there would be no drama.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Besides, pushing herself this far is...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I'm scared... just a little.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes... If I only half-ass it and fail to 
find my inner "core"...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Defeated in talent, defeated in 
impression. The path to becoming the 
"strongest" is completely shut.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want to end up like that! As if 
I'd ever let that happen. That's why—"

Royce and Royce was desperate. Yes, just 
like that time in the past—

Nice Nature, too, had lived through a 
bittersweet youth competing against Tokai 
Teio—

Through that struggle, she came to be 
recognized by the fans. As if following in 
those very hoofprints.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide-san, Ticket-san, I'm counting on 
you both!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Mmh... Royce-kun?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are you somehow even more energetic 
than at training camp?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm not fine. In fact, I might be 
feeling even more down than you guys.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Even so! I don't want to just end up as 
someone superficial!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Hayahide-san, Ticket-san—it's a showdown.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I didn't come here today to live out some 
meticulously calculated youth like last 
year!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I have to know who I am. No matter what. 
That's why――"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"To you, my peerless rivals who draw that 
out of me, I will give it everything I 
have!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Royce... I'm not quite sure I understand, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"You have a different look on your face 
today than usual."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Very well. I was growing a bit tired of 
pondering anyway. Let us see what your 
spirit can do."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! Ooooh... I don't really get it, 
but I'm getting kinda fired up!"

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Royce-chan today... seems... a little 
different?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. She usually focuses on fan service, 
but... that was pretty cool!

—A small resolution. With that... a quiet 
passion began to spread.

Royce and Royce's journey of true 
self-discovery was about to begin.
